summary_en: 33,300 shares (0.11% of S/O) to be cancelled effective 2026-08-31 following termination of executive stock grant trust programme on 2026-07-31. Shares acquired at no cost on 2026-08-03 from Japan Custody Bank (trust account). Post-cancellation issued shares: 30,284,700; treasury: 150,158 shares (0.50%).
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares in Connection with Termination of Executive Stock Grant Trust
translation_en_brief: Chikaranomoto Holdings announced on 13 August 2026 the cancellation of 33,300 treasury shares acquired without cost from Japan Custody Bank (trust account) on 3 August 2026. The shares were acquired as a result of the termination of the executive stock grant trust programme on 31 July 2026. The cancellation is scheduled for 31 August 2026 and represents 0.11% of issued shares outstanding at the time of cancellation. Following the cancellation, the company will have 30,284,700 issued shares and 150,158 treasury shares (0.50% of post-cancellation issued total), including 77,780 shares held in the stock grant ESOP trust account.
